Fateful consensus — every scale composed

Composing: CPM ⊕ vertex ⊕ munk (shape/position/area consensus tissue) ⊗ an SBML-ODE metabolism ⊗ a MaBoSS fate network, per cell. The information flows top-down: each cell's CPM-owned area sets its metabolic rate, the metabolite builds and pins the fate input, and the fate commits the cell. Fill colour = fate state (green metabolising → amber building → red committed).
